cards.title: Beneath the Mountains
cards.gameText: Tale. Fellowship: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to play a [DWARVEN] weapon from your discard pile. Fellowship: Spot a Dwarf to discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck.
cards.lore: “‘There forged was blade, and bound was hilt; / The delver mined, the mason built.'”

cards.title: Frór
cards.subtitle: Gimli's Kinsman
cards.gameText: To play, spot a Dwarf. While skirmishing an Uruk-hai, Fror is strength +3.
cards.lore: “It appeared that amid the splendour of their works of hand the hearts of the Dwarves of the Lonely Mountain were troubled.”

cards.title: Glóin
cards.subtitle: Friend to Thorin
cards.gameText: For each [DWARVEN] tale you can spot, Gloin is strength +1 (limit +4).
cards.lore: “‘But what then would happen, if the Ruling Ring were destroyed, as you counsel?'”

cards.title: Make Light of Burdens
cards.gameText: Maneuver: Exert a Dwarf and hinder an item borne by that Dwarf to hinder a Shadow condition (if that condition is a weather or borne by a Dwarf, discard it instead).
cards.lore: A Dwarf does not readily notice the weight on his back, or in his heart.

cards.title: Realm of Dwarrowdelf
cards.gameText: Plays to your support area. Skirmish: Discard the top 3 cards from your draw deck to make a Dwarf strength +1 (limit +3) and, if underground, damage +1 (limit +3). You may then discard up to 30 cards from your draw deck 3 at a time.
cards.lore: “‘There must have been a mighty crowd of dwarves here... and every one of them busier than badgers....'”

cards.title: Secret Sentinels
cards.gameText: Exert an Elf ally to discard a condition (and hinder another Shadow condition if you can spot an Orc).
cards.lore: “‘Yet so little faith and trust do we find now in the world beyond Lothlórien... that we dare not by our own trust endanger our land.'”

cards.title: Flaming Brand
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a ranger. This weapon may be borne in addition to 1 other hand weapon. Skirmish: Make bearer strength +2 and damage +1 while bearing this item and skirmishing a Nazgul until the regroup phase (limit once per turn). Discard this possession at the start of the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “...a glimpse of Strider leaping out of the darkness with a flaming brand of wood in either hand.”

cards.title: Shield of Boromir
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a [gondor] companion. The minion archery total is -1. If bearer is Boromir, each minion skirmishing him does not gain strength bonuses from weapons. Skirmish: If bearer is Boromir, discard this to make him take no wounds.
cards.lore: Boromir bore the heirlooms of the Steward's house with pride.

cards.title: Beyond the Height of Men
cards.gameText: Exert an Uruk-hai to discard a Free Peoples armor, helm, or shield. Hinder up to 4 Free Peoples possessions if you can spot 6 companions or 8 [ISENGARD] cards.
cards.lore: “‘Whom do you serve?'”

cards.title: Demands of the Sackville-Bagginses
cards.gameText: To play, spot an [isengard] minion. Each time an ally exerts, add (1) (or (2) if that ally is [shire]).
cards.lore: “In the middle of the commotion, the Sackville-Bagginses arrived.”

cards.title: Lurtz's Sword
cards.gameText: Bearer must be a unique Uruk-hai. If bearer is Lurtz, he is damage +1. Each time bearer wins a skirmish, the Free Peoples player must wound a companion or discard the top 3 cards of their draw deck.
cards.lore: The Uruk giant laid down his bow and drew a broad-bladed weapon.

cards.title: No Business of Ours
cards.gameText: While you can spot an [ISENGARD] minion, this card is twilight cost -3. The Free Peoples player may not look at or reveal cards in any Shadow player's hand.
cards.lore: “‘Goblins? Cobblers! Far-off tales and children's stories, that's all that is!'”

cards.title: Too Much Attention
cards.gameText: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot an [ISENGARD] minion to take a minion into hand from your draw deck. The Free Peoples player may discard the top 5 cards of their draw deck to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘A little more caution from you – that is not a trinket you carry.'”

cards.title: Uruk Captain
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Shadow: Remove (1) and exert a unique Uruk-hai to play an Uruk-hai from your discard pile.
cards.lore: The captains marched the Uruk-hai to the great river without halting.

cards.title: Foul Things
cards.gameText: Shadow: Play a [MORIA] card from your discard pile.
cards.lore: “‘Something has crept, or has been driven out of dark waters under the mountains.'”

cards.title: Bill Ferny
cards.subtitle: Swarthy Sneering Fellow
cards.gameText: Nazgul are not roaming. While you can spot a Hobbit, the Free Peoples player may not assign a character to skirmish Bill Ferny. Discard Bill Ferny if underground.
cards.lore: “‘...as for Ferny, he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'”

cards.title: Helpless
cards.gameText: Bearer's special abilities cannot be used. Maneuver: If this is in your support area, exert a Nazgul to transfer this to a Ring-bound companion.
cards.lore: “He heard Frodo's voice, but it seemed to come from a great distance, or from under the earth, crying out strange words.”

cards.title: The Witch-king
cards.subtitle: Lord of the Nazgul
cards.gameText: Twilight. Return to Its Master cannot be played. Skirmishes involving The Witch-king cannot be canceled. Each time The Witch-king wins a skirmish, you may exert him to wound the Ring-bearer twice.
cards.lore: “‘A great king and sorcerer he was of old, and now he wields a deadly fear.'”

cards.title: Southern Spies
cards.gameText: If the Ring-bearer puts on The One Ring, spot a [SAURON] minion to add a burden for each card in the Free Peoples player's hand. The Free Peoples player may discard their hand to prevent this.
cards.lore: “‘They will know all the news now, for they have visited Bill Ferny; and probably that Southerner was a spy as well.'”

cards.title: Filibert Bolger
cards.subtitle: Wily Rascal
cards.gameText: Skirmish: Exert a Hobbit companion twice (except the Ring-bearer) to cancel a fierce skirmish involving that Hobbit.
cards.lore: Filibert knows paths and tracks that few have trodden. He is not adventurous by nature, but his escapades often require rapid departures.

cards.title: Merry
cards.subtitle: Horticulturalist
cards.gameText: Fellowship: Exert Merry to take a Hobbit ally into hand from your draw deck (limit once per turn).
cards.lore: “‘Ow... I think I've broken somehing.'”

cards.title: Not Feared in Sunlight
cards.gameText: To play, spot 2 Hobbits. Fellowship: Discard this condition to make each Nazgul strength -4 until the regroup phase.
cards.lore: “‘...our shapes cast shadows in their minds, which only the noon sun destroys....'”

cards.title: O Elbereth! Gilthoniel!
cards.gameText: Tale. Bearer must be the Ring-bearer. Skirmish: Discard this condition to make the Ring-bearer strength +4 if skirmishing a Nazgul or to take off The One Ring.
cards.lore: “With a last effort Frodo... slipped the Ring from his finger and closed his right hand tight upon it.”

cards.title: Pippin
cards.subtitle: Mr. Took
cards.gameText: Each time you play a companion, you may play an item on them from your discard pile (at twilight cost -2 if that companion is Gandalf or Aragorn).
cards.lore: “Pippin was evidently much enjoying the attention he was getting, and had become quite forgetful of their danger.”

cards.title: Gimli
cards.subtitle: Dwarf of the Mountain-race
cards.gameText: Damage +1. Each underground site's Shadow number is -1.  While the fellowship is at an underground site, Gimli is strength +1.
cards.lore: “‘In the ruins of the Dwarves, a dwarf's head will be less easy to bewilder than Elves or Men or Hobbits.'”
